_note: Bookstore card -> SMP book page aliases (Kevin 2026-11-16 16:5xZ: bookstore card images must open the SMP book page). Key = the card's Sanity title (or display title), normalised as BookstoreBody.astro norm() does (lower case, accents and punctuation to single spaces, '(... edition)' dropped). Value = candidate /books/<slug>/ pages in order; the FIRST one that is built on this build (pages-live.json, or every page on a BOOKS_PREVIEW_ALL=1 preview) wins. A card whose title already equals a ship-set title or slug needs no entry. A card with no built candidate keeps its store link until its page is live.
